skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of multimedia technologies, including audio, image, and video processing, multimedia databases, and virtual reality.
Extract and process data from the Internet using multimedia technologies.
Process and analyze audio data, including sound transformation and feature extraction.
Process and analyze image data, including image compression techniques.
Process and analyze video data, including video compression techniques.
Understand and design multimedia databases, including data structures and query languages.
Understand and apply concepts of virtual reality and related systems.
Develop the ability to work independently and in groups, understanding responsibilities and professional ethics.
Apply problem-solving skills to multimedia technology challenges.
Enhance critical thinking skills in multimedia technology contexts.
